links.outcome: Patient knowledge, nurse time, and adherence with LLM chatbot vs traditional education in randomized trial
links.effect: Postintervention knowledge median 80.0 vs 75.0 (P=.01); nurse time median 5.0 vs 23.0 minutes (P<.001); adherence effects mostly nonsignificant (total adherence P=.33)
links.quote: The OPBot group showed significantly higher postintervention knowledge scores than the control group (median 80.0, IQR 70.0-89.0 vs median 75.0, IQR 65.5-80.0; P=.01).

screen.reason: The study evaluated the preliminary effectiveness and feasibility of an LLM chatbot (OPBot) for patient education versus standard care in a randomized controlled trial, but did not compare specific deployment practices or guardrails.
